Event.description: Each record identifies a specific cryoconite sampling site on Flade Isblink ice cap.

Latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each sample location.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each cryoconite sample location.

Date/Time.description: Sampling timestamps recorded between 22:00 and 02:00 on 2‑4 August 2022.

Sample ID.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers for individual cryoconite samples collected from Flade Isblink ice cap.

Depth ice/snow.description: Depth measurement recorded as zero for every sample in the dataset

Samp type.description: Sample material type, including cryoconite and glacial or non‑glacial river sediment.

Sample comment.description: Field records moisture state or river presence for each cryoconite sample.

Samp mat.description: Sample material classified as fine, intermediate, or granular.

LOI.description: Loss on ignition percentage of cryoconite sample organic matter.

137Cs.description: Cesium‑137 concentration in cryoconite samples, measured in becquerels per kilogram.

137Cs e.description: Cesium‑137 concentration in cryoconite, measured in becquerels per kilogram.

210Pb.description: 210Pb concentration in cryoconite samples, measured in becquerels per kilogram.

210Pb e.description: Lead‑210 activity concentration (Bq kg⁻¹) measured in cryoconite samples.

214Pb.description: Lead‑214 activity concentration in cryoconite samples.

214Pb e.description: Lead‑214 concentration in cryoconite samples, typical values near five.

241Am.description: Americium‑241 concentration in cryoconite, measured in becquerels per kilogram.

241Am e.description: Americium‑241 activity concentration measured in environmental samples, expressed as continuous numeric values.

207Bi.description: Bismuth‑207 concentration in cryoconite samples, reported as continuous numeric values.

207Bi e.description: Measured concentration of 207Bi in cryoconite samples.

7Be e.description: Beryllium‑7 activity concentration in becquerels per kilogram of cryoconite.

40K.description: Potassium‑40 activity measured in becquerels per kilogram.

40K e.description: Potassium‑40 activity concentration in becquerels per kilogram.

238Pu.description: Measured activity concentration of plutonium‑238 in cryoconite samples.

238Pu_2.description: Probability score for 238Pu detection in cryoconite samples, ranging from 0 to 1.

239+240Pu.description: Plutonium‑239+240 concentration in Bq per kilogram of cryoconite.

239+240Pu e.description: Plutonium‑239+240 activity concentration in becquerels per kilogram.

238/(239+240)Pu.description: Ratio of 238Pu to combined 239Pu + 240Pu activity, expressed as a dimensionless proportion.

238/(239+240)Pu e.description: Ratio of 238Pu to combined 239Pu + 240Pu activity in cryoconite samples.

240Pu/239Pu atom std dev.description: Standard deviation of the 240Pu/239Pu atomic ratio, expressed as a probability score.

240Pu/239Pu atom.description: Atomic ratio of 240Pu to 239Pu in cryoconite samples.

Elevation.description: Elevation of sampling site in meters.

966669.description: Cryoconite samples from Flade Isblink ice cap, including radionuclide concentrations and metadata, 2‑4 Aug 2022.

description: 48 records of Earth environmental measurements collected between 2022‑08‑02 and 2022‑08‑04.
